lines.japanese: 「佐久間君。あの、胸パッドちゃん、ていうのは……？」
lines.english: “Sakuma. Um, when you said ‘chest-pad girl’...?”

lines.japanese: 「ぬゎ～に、ゆっちゃってんのォ！　アンタが囲ってるコレでしょお～、１０８人いるって噂のォ！」
lines.english: “Whaddaya talking about? One of the chicks you're keeping on the side, right? Rumor says you've got a hundred and eight of 'em!”

lines.japanese: 彼は中指を突きたてて力説した。
lines.english: He thrust up his middle finger to drive the point home.

lines.japanese: 「俺とアニキが出逢った夜だよ、モンキの地下でアンタら夫婦に豪華ディナーおごってあげたジャ～ン」
lines.english: “The night you and I met! I treated you and the missus to that fancy dinner in Monki's basement, remember?”

lines.japanese: 豪華ディナー、という言葉がトリガーになって、僕ではななかった僕の記憶が流れこんできた。
lines.english: The words “fancy dinner” opened the floodgates, and memories of the me who had not been me came pouring in.

lines.japanese: モンキホーテの地下フードコート。
lines.english: The basement food court at Monki Hote.

lines.japanese: 佐久間君におごってもらった舶来ものの３０円コーラ。
lines.english: The imported thirty-yen cola Sakuma had treated us to.

lines.japanese: 成田君だった僕の、あのとき隣りにいたのは、香田……さんだ。
lines.english: The girl beside the me who had been Narita that night was... Kouda.

lines.japanese: 成田君のお友達の香田亜衣さん。
lines.english: Ai Kouda, Narita's friend.

lines.japanese: 森里君の大好きな香田亜衣さん。
lines.english: Ai Kouda, the girl Morisato loved.

lines.japanese: 胸パッドを愛用している、香田亜衣さん。
lines.english: Ai Kouda, devoted user of bra pads.

lines.japanese: 「……うん、分かった。思いだしたよ」
lines.english: “...Okay. I know who you mean now.”

lines.japanese: 「んイェス！　そんでェ、その胸パッドちゃんがこないだ、なんかチャラいヤローに囲まれててェ」
lines.english: “Nnnyes! Sooo, the other day, that chest-pad chick had some sleazy-looking dude hanging around her—”

lines.japanese: 「はーん！　アニキの大事な肉壺１０７号がピィーンチ！　ヤベエあの野郎やっちゃうか？　やっちまうか？　つって、俺ドッジャァーンつって割って入ったわけ！」
lines.english: “Haaahn! Bro's precious Fuckhole Number 107 is in peeeril! Oh shit, do I waste this guy? Do I do it? And then I went DOGYAAAN and jumped right in!”

lines.japanese: 「ちょおっと待ったァ！　ヘ～イそこのアンチャンさァ、だだだだァ～レのナオンに声かけちゃってンのかなァ！？」
lines.english: “Hoooold it right there! Hey, buddy-boy! J-j-j-j-just whoooose woman do you think you're hitting on?!”

lines.japanese: 「……あれ、佐久間君？」
lines.english: “...Oh. Sakuma?”

lines.japanese: 「あッはァ～ン！　お久しぶりだねェ、胸パッドの姐さん！　おぐぇん気ィー？　のゎーんつって、ンなこと言ってる場合じゃねーんだったァ──」
lines.english: “Ahaaaahn! Long time no see, Big Sis Chest Pads! How ya beeeen?—wait, this ain't the time for that—”

lines.japanese: 「──っつーワケで、おうアンチャン。相手見てナンパしろや。その方はテメーごとき三下が声かけていい相手じゃねえんだよ」
lines.english: “—so listen up, buddy. Take a look at who you're trying to pick up. A third-rate punk like you doesn't even get to talk to this lady.”

lines.japanese: 「え、そうなんスか」
lines.english: “Oh, is that right?”

lines.japanese: 「あはは！　もしか佐久間君、私のこと助けにきてくれた系？」
lines.english: “Ahaha! Sakuma, did you, like, come over here to rescue me?”

lines.japanese: 「イェス、ジャスティス！　正義の咲夜ただいま参上！」
lines.english: “Yes, justice! Sakuya, champion of righteousness, has arrived!”

lines.japanese: 「ありがちゅー！　でもゴメンぴ、このひとフツーに友達」
lines.english: “Thankies! But sowwy, this guy's just a regular friend.”

lines.japanese: 「あるぇええええ！？」
lines.english: “Whaaaaaaaaaat?!”

lines.japanese: 「つーか、俺Ｄカップ未満は異性として認識しねえし」
lines.english: “I mean, I don't even register anybody below a D cup as the opposite sex.”

lines.japanese: 「まじだ、らっきぃー」
lines.english: “He really doesn't. Lucky me!”

lines.japanese: 「つーか、こいつＲ‐ウィングのサクヤとか言う馬鹿じゃん」
lines.english: “Wait, isn't this moron Sakuya from R-Wing?”

lines.japanese: 「シャアアア！　そういうテメエは、よく見りゃフレイム馬鹿ーズか！　おのれ、よくぞこの俺をたばかった！　もう許さねえ、ぜってー泣かしたるぁあああヴぁばばばばば！　喰らえ、安男スラッシュ！」
lines.english: “SHAAAA! And now that I look at you, you're one of those Flame Birdbrains! Curse you! You deceived me! No forgiveness! I'll make you cry, I sweeearrrrblblblbl! Take this—Yasuo Slash!”

lines.japanese: 「え？　待って佐久間君、そんな、喧嘩はだめだよ」
lines.english: “What? Wait, Sakuma. You can't fight.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああそう？　そーゆーこと言っちゃうの？　ンじゃ～、そこンとこは飛ばすけどォ」
lines.english: “Oh. Oh, yeah? You're gonna say that? Okaaay, then we'll skip that part.”

lines.japanese: 「でェ、そのあと三人でモンキ行って、高級ディナーおごったったワケよ」
lines.english: “Sooo, after that, the three of us went to Monki and I treated 'em to a fancy dinner.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、急に仲良くなっちゃったの？」
lines.english: “Huh? You suddenly became friends?”

lines.japanese: 「しゃーねえじゃん、負けた方がおごるって話だったンだから」
lines.english: “What else was I supposed to do? Loser had to buy. That was the deal.”

lines.japanese: 「負けちゃったんだ……」
lines.english: “You lost...”

lines.japanese: 「きったねえよな、あいつ。空手なんてやってンだったら先言えってんだよ。俺、習い事ったら書道とバイオリンだじぇえ？　勝てるかボケ！」
lines.english: “Guy fought dirty. If he does karate, he's gotta tell me that first. The only lessons Yasuo ever took were calligraphy and violin, y'know? How the hell am I supposed to win?!”

lines.japanese: 「ま、そんなカンジで三人で話しててェ。ンーで、俺がなんかの拍子でアニキの話をしたときなんだけど、なんか急に胸パッドの姐さんがポカーンとしちゃって」
lines.english: “Anyway, the three of us got to talking. Then I happened to mention you, Bro, and all of a sudden Big Sis Chest Pads just went blank.”

lines.japanese: 「え……いまキミ、なんて言った？」
lines.english: “Wait... what did you just say?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だから俺、昼休みは最近よく、アニキと学食でナポリタン食ってるって」
lines.english: “I said lately I've been eating Napolitan with Bro in the cafeteria a lot at lunch.”

lines.japanese: 「はああいいぃぃーッ！？」
lines.english: “Whaaaaaaaat?!”

lines.japanese: 「ぃぃぃー……って耳いてぇー。なァーんよ、いきなりデッカイ声出しちゃってェ」
lines.english: “Aaaaaat—ow, my ears. What's with the sudden megaphone voice?”

lines.japanese: 「うそっ、まじで、ありえんてぃー！　だって隼人君ガッコ行ってるわけないじゃん、意味わかんない！」
lines.english: “No way! Seriously? That's impossi-tastic! Hayato can't be going to school! That makes no sense!”

lines.japanese: 「わかんない言われたって。んじゃ、こんどうちの学校見に来りゃＥジャン。動かぬ証拠を目撃しちゃえばＥジャン。美空学園のイケメンふたりを見に来ちゃえばＥジャン」
lines.english: “Dunno what to tell ya. Come see our school sometime—E-Z! Check out the rock-solid proof—E-Z! Come see Misora Academy’s two hottest guys—E-Z!”

lines.japanese: 「ええ……？　なんで……隼人君が……」
lines.english: “What...? Why would... Hayato...?”

lines.japanese: 「──ってわけで、胸パッドねーさん腰抜かしちゃってさァ！　いやあ～、そんなに驚いちゃったのかねえ、俺がナポリタン好きなことに」
lines.english: “—and then Big Sis Chest Pads's legs just gave out! Man, who knew she'd be that shocked to hear I like Napolitan?”

lines.japanese: ううん、佐久間君。たぶん香田さんが驚いたのはそこじゃないと思うよ。
lines.english: No, Sakuma. I don't think that was what shocked Kouda.

lines.japanese: 「ま、そういうことだからさ、今度あの子にあったら伝えといてよ。俺ミートソースも食えるから心配しないでって」
lines.english: “Anyway, next time you see her, tell her not to worry. I can eat meat sauce spaghetti too.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、うん……分かった。もし、会ったらね。もし、会えたら……」
lines.english: “Oh, sure... I will. If I see her. If I can see her...”

lines.japanese: 「な～にアニキ、胸パッドちゃんこと肉壺１０７号とは最近疎遠気味ィ？」
lines.english: “What's wrong, Bro? Things been getting distant lately between you and Chest-Pad Chick, alias Fuckhole Number 107?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね……ちょっと、色々あって……会いづらくなっちゃったんだ……」
lines.english: “Yeah... A few things happened... and now it's hard to see her...”

lines.japanese: 「はーん、分かる分かる！　一日七回もやってれば、そりゃーありきたりなプレイじゃ満たされなくなるよねェ。女ってのァ、男の子のそーゆとこ理解がないから──」
lines.english: “Haaahn, I get it, I get it! If you do it seven times a day, of course the same old vanilla stuff ain't gonna satisfy you anymore. Women just don't understand that side of a guy—”

lines.japanese: 「──っとヤベェ！　もうすぐホームルーム始まっちゃうじぇい！」
lines.english: “—oh, shit! Homeroom's about to start, jay!”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね、急ごっか」
lines.english: “You're right. Let's hurry.”

lines.japanese: 僕と佐久間君は教室まで走る羽目になった。
lines.english: Sakuma and I ended up running all the way to the classroom.

lines.japanese: けれど香田さんが変わらず元気みたいで、そのことだけはとても嬉しかった。
lines.english: But I was very glad to hear that Kouda was still doing well.
